overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Penn State Nittany Lions men's wrestling team for winning the 2026 NCAA Division I national championship, the top level of college wrestling. The resolution notes this was the team's fifth championship in a row and its 13th since 2011. It recognizes the hard work of the wrestlers, coaches, and staff. It is a ceremonial statement and does not change any law or spending. As of September 16, 2026, the Senate had agreed to it.
for: Supporters say the resolution rightly recognizes an unusual run of success and the discipline of the students and coaches behind it.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
